name: San Cristóbal Island (Chatham Island), Galápagos
name_zh: 加拉帕戈斯 · 圣克里斯托巴尔岛
note: 1835 年 9 月，小猎犬号在这座当时叫查塔姆岛的岛上第一次靠岸，达尔文在加拉帕戈斯一共待了五个星期。他后来写道，在这些年轻的火山岛上，“无论在空间还是时间上”，人似乎都离那个“谜中之谜”——地球上新物种最初的出现——近了一步。岛上的巴克里索莫雷诺港是群岛首府，港口海滩上躺满了海狮，城外的蒂赫雷塔斯山上立着达尔文像。二十年后梅尔维尔在《魔法群岛》里把这些岛比作“二十五堆煤渣”
note_en: In September 1835 the Beagle made her first landfall in the Galápagos here, on what was then called Chatham Island, and Darwin spent five weeks in the islands. On these young volcanic islands, he later wrote, 'both in space and time' we seem brought nearer to 'that mystery of mysteries', the first appearance of new species on earth. Puerto Baquerizo Moreno, the capital of the archipelago, has sea lions sprawled all over its beaches, and a statue of Darwin stands on Cerro Tijeretas just outside town. Melville, who knew the islands from his whaling days, likened them to 'five-and-twenty heaps of cinders'

name: Floreana Island (Charles Island), Galápagos
name_zh: 加拉帕戈斯 · 弗洛雷阿纳岛
note: 就是在这座当时叫查尔斯岛的岛上，副总督劳森告诉达尔文，他一眼就能看出一只象龟是从哪个岛来的——达尔文起初没当回事，后来才意识到这是整个群岛最了不起的事实。梅尔维尔当过捕鲸水手，在《魔法群岛》里写了一位在这里自立为王、靠一群狗维持统治的“狗王”。岛北的邮局湾至今还有捕鲸者留下的木桶“邮局”，游客照旧把明信片投进去，等下一个人顺路带走
note_en: It was on this island, then called Charles Island, that the vice-governor, Mr. Lawson, told Darwin he could tell at a glance which island any tortoise came from. Darwin paid little attention at first, and only later realized it was the most remarkable fact about the whole archipelago. Melville, who had sailed these waters on a whaler, wrote in The Encantadas of a 'Dog-King' who made himself ruler here and kept power with a pack of dogs. At Post Office Bay on the north shore, the whalers' barrel 'post office' still stands, and visitors still drop postcards in it for the next traveler to carry home

name: Chimborazo
note: 因为地球赤道隆起，钦博拉索山顶是离地心最远的地方。1802 年洪堡爬到了约 5,900 米，创下此后三十年的人类登高纪录；据说 1822 年玻利瓦尔也来到这里，写下散文诗《我在钦博拉索山上的狂想》，写自己在山顶遇见了“时间老人”。山脚的保护区里可以看到成群的骆马
note_en: Because the earth bulges at the equator, the summit of Chimborazo is the point on its surface farthest from its center. In 1802 Alexander von Humboldt climbed to about 5,900 meters, a human altitude record that stood for three decades, and in 1822, the story goes, Simón Bolívar came here too and wrote the prose poem My Delirium on Chimborazo, in which he meets Father Time at the summit. Herds of vicuña graze in the reserve around its base
